title: Count Pseudo-Palindromic Root-to-Leaf Paths
problemStatement: Given a binary tree whose node values represent digits, determine the number of root-to-leaf paths whose node values can be rearranged to form a palindrome.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
output: • Print the number of pseudo-palindromic paths.
